pain_points: Support agents spend too long researching customer context across tools
Ticket volume growing faster than headcount
Inconsistent answers from fragmented knowledge bases
Slow time-to-first-response on complex B2B accounts
buying_triggers: Series A/B funding followed by support hiring
New VP/Head of Support or CX
Enterprise tier launch increasing ticket complexity
Migration off legacy helpdesk or competitor CX stack
summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS companies (roughly 20–500 employees) in the US and Europe whose Customer Support / CX orgs are scaling after funding, leadership changes, or enterprise expansion — and who need AI to automate support research so agents resolve complex tickets faster.
